Today's selection covers 84 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 54 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 59 articles published in the last 24 hours
